cases.name: Helen Elizabeth Showalter
cases.about: Her obituary was, "A graduate of Ottumwa High School, Helen had worked at Sunnyslope Care Center, Reliable Drug, Target and Anne G. Wilson Elementary where she was known as Miss Helen. Most recently she worked cleaning the Veterans Clinic and did cleaning for others. Helen attended Bible Baptist Church in her youth and most recently Ottumwa Community Church. Helen loved being outdoors and hiking. She had served as a Scout Master for Troop #218." Her oldest son, Chris, says his mother was a “doting grandmother” and “lover of the outdoors.” Another son Greg touched on his mother’s legacy saying, he will carry with him the honesty and integrity she taught him to have as a kid calling her an “amazing person.”
cases.narrative: He lured her to a job site, killing her and dumping her body in the Des Moines River river.
